subcommands.name: create-environment

options.name: --name
options.description: The name of the Amazon MWAA environment. For example, MyMWAAEnvironment

options.name: --execution-role-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the execution role for your environment.

options.name: --source-bucket-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Amazon S3 bucket where your DAG code and supporting files are stored.

options.name: --dag-s3-path
options.description: The relative path to the DAGs folder on your Amazon S3 bucket. For example, dags. For more information, see Adding or updating DAGs

options.name: --network-configuration
options.description: The VPC networking components used to secure and enable network traffic between the Amazon Web Services resources for your environment.

options.name: --plugins-s3-path
options.description: The relative path to the plugins.zip file on your Amazon S3 bucket. For example, plugins.zip. If specified, then the plugins.zip version is required.

options.name: --plugins-s3-object-version
options.description: The version of the plugins.zip file on your Amazon S3 bucket. You must specify a version each time a plugins.zip file is updated.

options.name: --requirements-s3-path
options.description: The relative path to the requirements.txt file on your Amazon S3 bucket. For example, requirements.txt. If specified, then a version is required.

options.name: --requirements-s3-object-version
options.description: The version of the requirements.txt file on your Amazon S3 bucket. You must specify a version each time a requirements.txt file is updated.

options.name: --startup-script-s3-object-version
options.description: The version of the startup shell script in your Amazon S3 bucket.

options.name: --airflow-configuration-options
options.description: A list of key-value pairs containing the Apache Airflow configuration options you want to attach to your environment.

options.name: --environment-class
options.description: The environment class type. Valid values: mw1.micro, mw1.small, mw1.medium, mw1.large, mw1.xlarge, and mw1.2xlarge.

options.name: --max-workers
options.description: The maximum number of workers that you want to run in your environment.

options.name: --kms-key
options.description: The Amazon Web Services Key Management Service (KMS) key to encrypt the data in your environment.

options.name: --airflow-version
options.description: The Apache Airflow version for your environment. If no value is specified, it defaults to the latest version.

options.name: --logging-configuration
options.description: Defines the Apache Airflow logs to send to CloudWatch Logs

options.name: --weekly-maintenance-window-start

options.name: --tags
options.description: The key-value tag pairs you want to associate to your environment. For example, "Environment": "Staging".

options.name: --webserver-access-mode
options.description: Defines the access mode for the Apache Airflow web server. For more information, see Apache Airflow access modes

options.name: --min-workers
options.description: The minimum number of workers that you want to run in your environment.
